name: Right Knee X-Ray (AP & Lateral) & CRP
instructions: Bring previous operative X-ray films. Fasting not required.
preparationChecklist: Bring previous operative X-ray films and discharge summary
Wear loose-fitting trousers or shorts allowing knee exposure
Take morning medications with water as scheduled (no fasting required)
Arrive at Room 102 at least 15 minutes before 09:30 AM
sourceSentence: Post-operative right knee X-ray (AP & Lateral) and CRP test scheduled on October 12, 2026.

name: Fasting Lipid Profile, ECG & Electrolytes
instructions: Overnight fasting (10-12 hours) required for accurate lipid measurement.
preparationChecklist: Strict overnight fasting for 10-12 hours prior to 08:30 AM (plain water allowed)
Avoid heavy physical exertion, caffeine, and smoking on the morning of test
Hold morning blood pressure / cardiac medications until blood sample is drawn
Bring hospital discharge card & national ID for admission verification
Arrive at Cardiac Diagnostics Wing by 08:15 AM
sourceSentence: Follow-up 12-lead ECG, Lipid Profile and Serum Electrolytes scheduled on October 6, 2026.

name: Repeat Chest X-Ray & Complete Blood Count (CBC)
instructions: Wear loose clothing. No fasting required.
preparationChecklist: Wear comfortable clothing with no metal zippers, snaps, or necklaces
Light breakfast permitted (no fasting required for routine CBC & X-Ray)
Drink 1-2 glasses of water before coming to help vein access
Bring doctor's lab requisition slip and government ID
Arrive at Pulmonology Lab 15 minutes early
sourceSentence: Chest X-ray and CBC follow-up scheduled on October 10, 2026.

name: Left Ankle X-Ray (Weight-Bearing Series)
instructions: Use crutches when arriving at the diagnostic center.
preparationChecklist: Bring crutches or walking aid for safe weight-bearing transition
Wear removable footwear and loose trousers/shorts
Take prescribed pain medication 1 hour before appointment if experiencing discomfort
Bring operative discharge notes and prior ankle radiographs
sourceSentence: Weight-bearing ankle radiography review scheduled on October 4, 2026.

name: HbA1c & Fasting Blood Glucose (FBG)
instructions: 8-10 hours fasting prior to blood draw. Take morning Metformin after blood sample is taken.
preparationChecklist: Strict 8-10 hours overnight fasting before the 08:00 AM sample collection
Hold morning dose of Metformin / anti-diabetic medications until after the blood draw
Carry your morning breakfast & medications to consume immediately after blood draw
Drink 1-2 glasses of plain water in the morning to aid vein access
sourceSentence: Fasting blood sugar and HbA1c lab evaluation scheduled on October 13, 2026.

name: Complete Blood Count (CBC) & Liver Function Test (LFT)
preparationChecklist: Overnight fasting (minimum 6-8 hours) recommended for accurate enzyme levels
Drink water freely to remain hydrated
Avoid alcohol and heavy/fatty meals the evening before
Take daily non-diabetic routine medicines with a sip of water unless told otherwise
sourceSentence: Routine blood count and liver panel scheduled on October 11, 2026.

name: Pelvic & Hip Radiography Series
instructions: Assisted wheelchair access available at entrance.
preparationChecklist: Wheelchair assistance is available at the main entrance if needed
Wear elastic-waist pants without metal buttons or zippers
Bring previous post-arthroplasty implant documentation
Continue regular medications with water
sourceSentence: Post-arthroplasty pelvic X-ray series scheduled on October 15, 2026.

name: Abdominal Ultrasound & Hemoglobin Check
instructions: Drink 500ml water 1 hour prior to scan; do not void bladder.
preparationChecklist: Drink 500 mL (approx. 2 full glasses) of plain water 1 hour prior to scan
Do not empty / void bladder until ultrasound scan is completed
Wear a two-piece loose outfit allowing easy abdominal access
Bring past ultrasound and abdominal imaging reports
sourceSentence: Abdominal ultrasonography review scheduled on October 12, 2026.
